def fingerprint(value):
 a=np.ascontiguousarray(value);return {'shape':list(a.shape),'dtype':a.dtype.str,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(a.tobytes()).hexdigest()}

def mask_reference(target):
 height,width=target.shape[-2:]
 def maximum(value):
  padded=np.pad(value,((0,0),(0,0),(0,0),(8,8)),mode='edge');result=padded[...,:width].copy()
  for i in range(1,17):np.maximum(result,padded[...,i:i+width],out=result)
  padded=np.pad(result,((0,0),(0,0),(8,8),(0,0)),mode='edge');result=padded[...,:height,:].copy()
  for i in range(1,17):np.maximum(result,padded[...,i:i+height,:],out=result)
  return result
 ranges=(maximum(target)+maximum(-target)).max(1,keepdims=True);mask=ranges<=1/65535
 return {'values':fingerprint(mask),'eligible_pixels':int(mask.sum()),'total_pixels':mask.size,'per_image_eligible_pixels':[int(v.sum()) for v in mask]}
